name: Humayun
role: Mughal emperor in the Bengal campaign era
contribution: He led the Mughal eastern campaign that entered Bengal and occupied Gaur before the reversals at Chausa and Kannauj.
context: His conflict with Sher Shah Suri framed the first major Mughal-Afghan struggle over Bengal-adjacent power.
impact: His setbacks delayed stable Mughal control and opened a period of Afghan resurgence in north India and Bengal politics.
highlight: Humayun's Bengal campaign marked the first major Mughal intervention in Bengal's sixteenth-century power transition.
